push.title: W 6-2 vs WhoDisBic | You: 10.0 (top 10% FOR)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 10.0 against WhoDisBic. I'm gonna need a minute. Somebody hand me a tissue and a clipboard.

DID WELL
+ 2 of 2 shots on target. You picked good shots like picking ripe apples.
+ 2 goals from 2 on target. You hit the target and the target hit the net.
+ 4 key passes (up from your usual 2). Chance creation is generosity with a soccer ball.
+ A brace against WhoDisBic. Goals are like biscuits: always better shared, but I'll take this one.
+ Man of the Match, your 5th for us. You led by example, and the example was excellent.

WORK ON
- 71% passing (20 of 28). Start here: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
- Shots: 2. Decent, but top-quarter forwards get to 3+. That's the next rung.

Repetition station: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.

Hold onto this feeling. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 6-2 vs WhoDisBic | You: 9.9 (top 10% MID)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 9.9. I'm officially out of superlatives, and I keep a lot of 'em in my pocket.

DID WELL
+ 100% passing on 22 attempts, up from your usual 77%. Neat, tidy, and not a wasted touch.
+ A brace against WhoDisBic, your 4th straight match scoring. That's the stuff they write songs about. Bad songs, but songs.
+ 1 key pass. You're the reason the forwards have something to celebrate.
+ That partnership with PhogsToffees is starting to feel like a habit.
+ 2.0 up on your average. Momentum is a wonderful thing.

WORK ON
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.
- Passes attempted: 22. Next target: 25+.

Training ground: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.

Proud of you, partner. - Coach Lasso

players.name: tuxedo_slide

strengths.title: Defensive work rate
strengths.note: Puts in the defensive work and engages the ball carrier.
strengths.coach: You put your foot in and did the dirty work. That doesn't make highlight reels, but it wins matches.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Found the back of the net. Never gets old, does it?

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Made chances for your teammates. Unselfish football is the best kind.

weaknesses.detail: Pass accuracy: 61% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 71% or less)
weaknesses.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.
Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.
Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.
weaknesses.coach: The passing got a little loose out there.

weaknesses.detail: Won 2 of 9 tackles (22%) - diving in; each miss leaves a runner free
weaknesses.title: Tackle timing
tips: Press to cut the passing lane, not to lunge at the ball carrier from behind.
Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.
Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.
weaknesses.coach: Diving in a bit too eager. Patience in the tackle.

push.title: W 6-2 vs WhoDisBic | You: 9.1 (top 10% MID)
push.body:
Mercy me, tuxedo_slide. A 9.1. That one goes in the scrapbook, page one.

DID WELL
+ 9 tackles attempted (up from your usual 2). You covered more ground than a mail carrier.
+ A brace against WhoDisBic, your 4th straight match scoring. Goals change games, and you changed this one.
+ 1 key pass. You were the playmaker, the matchmaker and the good-time maker.
+ That connection with PhogsToffees is gold. Don't let it rust.
+ 1.6 over your norm. Whatever you ate for breakfast, keep eating it.

WORK ON
- 61% passing (11 of 18). Pass to the far foot of a teammate who's facing play; it lets them take it forward in one touch.
- Won 2 of 9 tackles. Press to cut the passing lane, not to lunge at the ball carrier from behind.
- 3 shots off target took 0.1. Head up first, then play.
- Passes attempted: 18. Halfway to the summit; the peak is 25+.

Training note: Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.

That's the kind of night that makes me glad I took this job. - Coach Lasso
